proof.lemma_E1: At the empty root context, an applicable clause reason must advertise the empty clause because the empty assignment cannot falsify a nonempty clause.
proof.corollary_E2: A root-applicable C025-B-v1 reason is therefore exactly a Resolution DAG refutation of the root CNF.
proof.external_lower_bound: Explicit polynomial-size pigeonhole CNFs require superpolynomial/exponential Resolution refutations; Haken 1985 is the classical source and its abstract explicitly notes polynomial extended-resolution proofs for these formulas.
proof.conclusion: No fixed exponent a can bound every C025-B-v1 portable root reason by N^a in original input bit length N.

important_note: The lower bound is on Resolution DAG proof size, so ordinary DAG sharing does not remove this obstruction.

candidate_next_language.name: C025_B2_EXTENSION_AWARE_REASON_V0
candidate_next_language.motivation: Extended Resolution removes the known pigeonhole obstruction: Haken's abstract states polynomial-length extended-resolution proofs exist for the pigeonhole formulas used for the Resolution lower bound.
candidate_next_language.claim_ceiling: This only removes one known lower-bound family; universal proof size and deterministic proof search remain open.
